project.name: smart-bookmark
project.description: Smart Bookmark - 书签清理 + 新标签页看板 + AI + 对比搜索 + 悬浮球 + 二维码 + 备份，浏览器扩展（Chrome / Edge，MV3）

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type definitions for the Smart Bookmark extension, defining all core interfaces and types used across the codebase (settings, bookmarks, AI messages, issues, etc.).

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Chrome storage abstraction layer providing get/set settings and change listener, bridging localStorage and chrome.storage.local for cross-context persistence.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Shared utility functions including CSS class merging (cn), favicon URL generation, hostname extraction, date formatting, debounce, and URL normalization.

nodes.name: bookmarks.ts
nodes.summary: Chrome bookmarks API wrapper providing tree traversal, CRUD operations (get/remove/move), flatten/allFolders helpers, and a mock tree for development.

nodes.name: qr.ts
nodes.summary: QR code generator converting text to data URL using the qrcode library with customizable size and color.

nodes.name: favicon.ts
nodes.summary: Favicon fetcher and cache manager using IndexedDB, with multi-strategy resolution (origin favicon, HTML parsing, background fetch) and no-icon caching.

nodes.name: themePresets.ts
nodes.summary: Theme preset definitions containing color schemes and accent configurations for the extension's UI theming system.

nodes.name: theme.ts
nodes.summary: Theme initialization and application logic that resolves system preferences, applies dark/light mode, accent colors, and watches for settings changes.

nodes.name: ai.ts
nodes.summary: AI chat backend supporting both OpenAI and Anthropic APIs with SSE streaming, tool call handling, and connection testing. Handles message format conversion and response parsing.

nodes.name: aiTools.ts
nodes.summary: Tool definitions for AI bookmark operations (query, create, move, delete, etc.) in both OpenAI and Anthropic function-calling formats.

nodes.name: aiBookmarkContext.ts
nodes.summary: Generates a text summary of the user's bookmark tree for AI context, with IndexedDB caching to avoid regenerating on every query.

nodes.name: bookmarkSummaryCache.ts
nodes.summary: IndexedDB-based cache for AI bookmark summaries with TTL-based invalidation and chrome.storage-based invalidation timestamps.

nodes.name: aiSessionDb.ts
nodes.summary: IndexedDB persistence layer for AI chat sessions, providing CRUD operations with auto-expiration (30-day TTL) and session listing sorted by recency.

nodes.name: cleaner.ts
nodes.summary: Bookmark cleaning engine that scans for empty folders, duplicates, broken URLs, and dead sites, plus builds a detailed organization profile with domain/keyword statistics and scoring.

nodes.name: engines.ts
nodes.summary: Search engine configuration and resolution, combining built-in engines (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, etc.) with user-defined custom engines.

nodes.name: github.ts
nodes.summary: GitHub trending repositories client using the search API with caching, snapshot-based star velocity tracking, language filtering, and markdown export.

nodes.name: i18n.ts
nodes.summary: Internationalization system supporting Chinese and English with locale detection, translation function (t), React hook (useT), and settings-driven language switching.

nodes.name: backup.ts
nodes.summary: Bookmark backup and restore supporting JSON and Netscape HTML formats, with import deduplication, folder creation, and download triggering.

nodes.name: markdown.tsx
nodes.summary: Custom React markdown renderer supporting headings, code blocks, tables, lists, blockquotes, horizontal rules, inline formatting, and links without external dependencies.

nodes.name: useFavicon.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that fetches and caches favicons for URLs, returning a stateful image source with refresh capability.

nodes.name: useNewsNowAuth.ts
nodes.summary: React hook for detecting NewsNow authentication state via Chrome cookies API with manual dismiss persistence and visibility-based rechecking.

nodes.name: button.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable button component with variant/size system built on Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS class merging.

nodes.name: card.tsx
nodes.summary: Card layout components (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter) for structured content display.

nodes.name: dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal dialog component wrapping Radix UI Dialog with overlay, content, header/footer layout helpers, and Tailwind styling.

nodes.name: dropdown-menu.tsx
nodes.summary: Dropdown menu component suite (trigger, content, items, checkbox items, labels, separators) built on Radix UI with custom styling.

nodes.name: input.tsx
nodes.summary: Styled text input component with consistent styling using Tailwind CSS and cn utility.

nodes.name: progress.tsx
nodes.summary: Progress bar component using Radix UI Progress primitive with animated indicator.

nodes.name: switch.tsx
nodes.summary: Toggle switch component wrapping Radix UI Switch with custom styling.

nodes.name: tabs.tsx
nodes.summary: Tab navigation components (Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent) using Radix UI with styled triggers.

nodes.name: toast.tsx
nodes.summary: Lightweight toast notification system with auto-dismiss, providing a global toast() function and ToastHost renderer component.

nodes.name: getSettings
nodes.summary: Reads extension settings from chrome.storage.local with localStorage fallback.

nodes.name: setSettings
nodes.summary: Merges partial settings update into chrome.storage.local and localStorage.

nodes.name: onSettingsChange
nodes.summary: Registers a listener for chrome.storage.onChanged events and returns cleanup function.

nodes.name: faviconOf
nodes.summary: Generates a favicon URL for a given page URL using Google's favicon service.

nodes.name: debounce
nodes.summary: Returns a debounced version of a function that delays execution until after a specified wait time.

nodes.name: normalizeUrl
nodes.summary: Normalizes URLs by stripping tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, spm), trailing slashes, and lowercasing for deduplication.

nodes.name: flatten
nodes.summary: Recursively flattens the bookmark tree into a flat array with path prefixes and depth information.

nodes.name: allFolders
nodes.summary: Extracts all folder nodes from the bookmark tree with their bookmark counts and paths.

nodes.name: mockTree
nodes.summary: Returns a mock bookmark tree structure for development and testing purposes.

nodes.name: toDataUrl
nodes.summary: Generates a QR code data URL from text input with configurable size and dark color.

nodes.name: getCachedFavicon
nodes.summary: Retrieves a cached favicon data URL from IndexedDB by origin, returning null if not found or marked as no-icon.

nodes.name: fetchFavicon
nodes.summary: Main favicon fetching strategy: checks cache, tries origin path, parses HTML for icon link tags, and caches results.

nodes.name: extractIconHref
nodes.summary: Extracts the icon href from HTML using regex matching against link tag patterns.

nodes.name: resolveIconUrl
nodes.summary: Resolves a relative icon href to an absolute URL using the base URL.

nodes.name: parseFaviconFromHtml
nodes.summary: Fetches the page HTML via background script, extracts icon hrefs (apple-touch-icon, icon, shortcut icon), and fetches the first valid one.

nodes.name: fetchAsDataUrl
nodes.summary: Fetches a URL and converts the response blob to a data URL using FileReader.

nodes.name: clearAllNoIconCache
nodes.summary: Iterates all IndexedDB entries and removes those marked as having no icon, allowing retry.

nodes.name: initTheme
nodes.summary: Initializes the theme system by reading settings, applying dark/light mode and accent colors, and watching for changes.

nodes.name: toApiMessages
nodes.summary: Converts internal message format (with tool calls/results) to OpenAI-compatible API message array.

nodes.name: chatOpenAI
nodes.summary: Sends a streaming chat request to OpenAI-compatible API, parsing SSE events and dispatching text deltas and tool calls.

nodes.name: chatAnthropic
nodes.summary: Sends a streaming chat request to Anthropic API with tool use support, managing tool call buffer accumulation and completion.

nodes.name: testAi
nodes.summary: Tests AI API connectivity by sending a simple message to both OpenAI and Anthropic endpoints, measuring latency and returning results.

nodes.name: parseOpenAiJsonBody
nodes.summary: Parses OpenAI response body that may contain SSE data or raw JSON, handling markdown code block wrapping.

nodes.name: readSse
nodes.summary: Reads Server-Sent Events from a ReadableStream, splitting on newlines and dispatching parsed events to callback.

nodes.name: generateFullSummary
nodes.summary: Generates a full text summary of all bookmarks including folder statistics and complete bookmark list for AI context.

nodes.name: getCachedSummary
nodes.summary: Retrieves cached bookmark summary from IndexedDB, checking invalidation status and returning null if stale or invalidated.

nodes.name: setCachedSummary
nodes.summary: Stores a bookmark summary in IndexedDB with a timestamp for staleness checking.

nodes.name: isInvalidated
nodes.summary: Checks if the summary cache has been invalidated by comparing chrome.storage timestamps, and cleans up the flag.

nodes.name: listSessions
nodes.summary: Lists all AI chat sessions from IndexedDB, filtering expired ones (30-day TTL) and sorting by most recent.

nodes.name: getSession
nodes.summary: Retrieves a single AI session by ID from IndexedDB.

nodes.name: createSession
nodes.summary: Creates a new AI session with a generated UUID, title, messages, and timestamps.

nodes.name: updateSession
nodes.summary: Updates an existing session's messages and optional title, refreshing the timestamp and auto-generating title from first user message if needed.

nodes.name: scanAll
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a full bookmark scan running empty folder, duplicate, broken URL, and dead site detection with progress callbacks.

nodes.name: scanEmptyFolders
nodes.summary: Identifies empty bookmark folders excluding system folders (Bookmarks Bar, Other, Mobile).

nodes.name: scanDuplicates
nodes.summary: Groups bookmarks by normalized URL and identifies duplicates with title variations for merge suggestions.

nodes.name: scanBrokenUrls
nodes.summary: Scans bookmarks for malformed URLs, non-standard protocols, and localhost addresses.

nodes.name: scanInvalid
nodes.summary: Probes HTTP/HTTPS bookmarks with HEAD requests to detect dead sites, with concurrency control and progress tracking.

nodes.name: pingAlive
nodes.summary: Sends a HEAD request to a URL with timeout and abort support to check if the site is reachable.

nodes.name: buildProfile
nodes.summary: Builds a comprehensive bookmark organization profile including domain statistics, date distribution, folder depth analysis, keyword extraction, and organization scoring.

nodes.name: calcLevel
nodes.summary: Determines the bookmark count level (Very Poor to Excellent) based on total bookmark count thresholds.

nodes.name: makeBadges
nodes.summary: Generates descriptive badge strings based on the bookmark profile's keywords and domains for AI context.

nodes.name: scoreOrg
nodes.summary: Calculates an organization score (0-100) based on empty folder ratio, duplicate ratio, and average folder depth.

nodes.name: toEngineDef
nodes.summary: Converts a custom engine config into a full engine definition with favicon URL and query template.

nodes.name: readCache
nodes.summary: Reads trending repository cache from localStorage with chrome.storage.local fallback.

nodes.name: readSnapshots
nodes.summary: Reads historical star count snapshots for velocity tracking from localStorage/chrome.storage.

nodes.name: rehydrateRepo
nodes.summary: Converts raw GitHub API repository data into a structured RepoInfo object with computed fields like full name and creation date.

nodes.name: fetchTrending
nodes.summary: Fetches trending repositories from GitHub API with language/sort/date filtering, caching, star velocity delta tracking, and rate limit handling.

nodes.name: buildCandidateQuery
nodes.summary: Constructs GitHub search query string from options including language, creation date range, and star thresholds.

nodes.name: sortRepos
nodes.summary: Sorts repository array by stars, recently created, or recently updated with secondary sort by star count.

nodes.name: applyDeltaFromSnapshots
nodes.summary: Computes star velocity (stars gained per hour) by comparing current counts with historical snapshots and updates the snapshot store.

nodes.name: trendingToMarkdown
nodes.summary: Converts a list of trending repositories into a formatted markdown string with numbered entries.

nodes.name: normalizeRepo
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw GitHub API repository data into a clean RepoInfo object with proper date parsing and fallback defaults.

nodes.name: initI18n
nodes.summary: Initializes the i18n system by resolving language from settings, registering a change listener, and notifying all subscribers.

nodes.name: useT
nodes.summary: React hook that returns the current translation function and re-renders on language changes.

nodes.name: buildBackup
nodes.summary: Builds a backup data structure by traversing the bookmark tree and converting to serializable format.

nodes.name: triggerDownload
nodes.summary: Triggers a file download by creating a temporary anchor element with a blob URL.

nodes.name: toNetscapeHtml
nodes.summary: Converts bookmark nodes to Netscape Bookmark File HTML format with proper DL/DT/DL nesting.

nodes.name: parseNetscapeHtml
nodes.summary: Parses Netscape Bookmark File HTML into structured bookmark nodes using DOMParser.

nodes.name: importIntoFolder
nodes.summary: Imports parsed bookmark nodes into a Chrome folder with deduplication, creating sub-folders and links recursively.

nodes.name: inline
nodes.summary: Parses inline markdown formatting (bold, italic, code, links, images) into React elements.

nodes.name: renderMarkdown
nodes.summary: Full markdown-to-React renderer supporting headings, code blocks, tables, lists, blockquotes, horizontal rules, and inline formatting.

nodes.name: useFavicon
nodes.summary: React hook that fetches a favicon for a URL and returns the data URL as state, with a refresh key for cache invalidation.

nodes.name: looksLikeAuthCookie
nodes.summary: Checks if a cookie value matches common authentication cookie patterns (JWT, session tokens).

nodes.name: useNewsNowAuth
nodes.summary: React hook that detects NewsNow authentication status via Chrome cookies API with visibility-based rechecking and manual dismiss support.

nodes.name: ToastHost
nodes.summary: Toast notification renderer that manages a queue of toast items with auto-dismiss after 3 seconds.

nodes.name: EngineSwitcher.tsx
nodes.summary: 搜索引擎切换器组件，提供下拉菜单让用户选择搜索引擎（内置或自定义），支持添加和删除自定义引擎。

nodes.name: FaviconImg.tsx
nodes.summary: Favicon 图片组件，优先加载真实 favicon，失败时回退到基于域名哈希色的首字母占位符。

nodes.name: FolderTree.tsx
nodes.summary: 可交互的书签文件夹树组件，支持展开/折叠、选择文件夹、固定文件夹，以及显示书签计数。

nodes.name: InfoCollections.tsx
nodes.summary: 信息集合面板组件，整合实时新闻、登录提示和快捷链接面板，为新标签页提供内容聚合功能。

nodes.name: LineChart.tsx
nodes.summary: 纯 SVG 折线图组件，接收数据数组和高度参数，渲染带有渐变填充和网格线的折线图。

nodes.name: RepoCard.tsx
nodes.summary: GitHub 仓库卡片组件，展示仓库的星标数、趋势数据、语言信息，支持一键添加书签和复制仓库地址。

nodes.name: ThemeSwitcher.tsx
nodes.summary: 主题切换器组件，以下拉菜单形式展示按家族分组的主题预设，支持实时预览和选择应用。

nodes.name: ThemeToggle.tsx
nodes.summary: 简易主题切换按钮，在明暗模式之间循环切换，通过 chrome.storage 持久化设置。

nodes.name: TrendingPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: GitHub 趋势面板组件，支持按时间范围、编程语言筛选趋势仓库，包含排序、模式切换和语言选择器。

nodes.name: EngineSwitcher
nodes.summary: 搜索引擎切换器主组件，管理引擎列表、自定义引擎的添加/删除，以及下拉菜单的展开/收起状态。

nodes.name: FaviconImg
nodes.summary: Favicon 图片组件，使用 useFavicon hook 获取真实图标，加载失败时渲染带哈希背景色的首字母占位符。

nodes.name: FolderTree
nodes.summary: 可交互书签文件夹树组件，使用 useMemo 扁平化树结构，支持展开/折叠、选择、固定和删除操作。

nodes.name: flattenForTree
nodes.summary: 递归遍历文件夹树并扁平化为带深度和子节点数信息的数组，用于渲染缩进树形结构。

nodes.name: InfoCollections
nodes.summary: 信息集合主组件，根据语言设置渲染新闻面板和链接面板，协调各子组件的布局和交互。

nodes.name: LiveNewsFrame
nodes.summary: 实时新闻 iframe 组件，使用 useNewsNowAuth hook 获取认证信息，通过消息机制与 iframe 通信。

nodes.name: LoginPromptButton
nodes.summary: 登录提示按钮组件，显示 NewsNow 登录提示，支持关闭操作，防止冒泡事件。

nodes.name: LineChart
nodes.summary: SVG 折线图组件，计算坐标映射、生成渐变填充路径和网格线，支持自动缩放和响应式高度。

nodes.name: RepoCard
nodes.summary: GitHub 仓库卡片组件，展示仓库描述、星标数、趋势指标、语言和话题标签，支持添加书签和复制操作。

nodes.name: ThemeSwitcher
nodes.summary: 主题切换器组件，支持 button 和 dropdown 两种变体，从 chrome.storage 加载当前主题，使用 MutationObserver 监听暗色模式变化。

nodes.name: ThemeToggle
nodes.summary: 简易主题切换按钮，在明暗模式之间循环切换，通过 onSettingsChange 监听设置变更。

nodes.name: TrendingPanel
nodes.summary: GitHub 趋势面板组件，管理加载状态、错误处理、排序和筛选，支持 daily/weekly/monthly 三种时间范围。

nodes.name: LanguagePicker
nodes.summary: 编程语言选择器组件，提供常用语言快速选择和自定义语言输入，支持点击外部关闭下拉菜单。

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: 新标签页入口文件，初始化国际化和主题后挂载 App 组件。

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: 新标签页主应用壳，通过 URL hash 路由管理 7 个标签页（Dashboard、Discover、Cleaner、Compare、AI、Backup、Settings），提供全局主题切换和 QR 弹窗功能。

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: 主应用组件，管理标签页状态、URL hash 同步、设置加载，渲染顶部标签栏和对应页面组件。

nodes.name: YearProgress
nodes.summary: 年度进度可视化组件，计算当前年份进度百分比并用单元格条形图展示。

nodes.name: Dashboard.tsx
nodes.summary: 新标签页核心看板页面，集成搜索引擎、书签文件夹树、拖拽排序、历史记录搜索、Top Sites、趋势面板和分页功能，是整个扩展最复杂的 UI 组件。

nodes.name: Dashboard
nodes.summary: 主看板组件，管理书签树加载、文件夹导航、搜索过滤、拖拽排序、右键菜单、分页、Top Sites 和趋势面板等所有看板逻辑。

nodes.name: buildBreadcrumb
nodes.summary: 从书签树中递归构建面包屑导航路径。

nodes.name: PageSizePicker
nodes.summary: 每页显示数量选择器组件，支持下拉选择 24/60/120/240 条。

nodes.name: buildPageRange
nodes.summary: 构建分页器的页码范围数组，支持省略号折叠。

nodes.name: BookmarkCard
nodes.summary: 单个书签卡片组件，支持拖拽排序、右键菜单和 favicon 显示。

nodes.name: Pager
nodes.summary: 分页器组件，支持上一页/下一页、页码跳转和省略号折叠。

nodes.name: BookmarkCtxMenu
nodes.summary: 书签右键上下文菜单组件，提供复制、QR 码、刷新图标和删除操作。

nodes.name: Settings.tsx
nodes.summary: 设置页面，管理搜索引擎、AI 配置、GitHub Token、趋势缓存、语言偏好、排序方式和主题预设等全部扩展配置项。

nodes.name: SettingsPage
nodes.summary: 设置页面组件，管理所有扩展配置项的加载、更新和 UI 渲染，包括搜索引擎、AI、GitHub、主题等配置。

nodes.name: Discover.tsx
nodes.summary: 发现页面，展示 GitHub 趋势项目面板，支持切换时间范围和排序方式。

nodes.name: Discover
nodes.summary: 发现页面组件，接收设置属性并渲染趋势面板。

nodes.name: QrDialog.tsx
nodes.summary: QR 码弹窗组件，根据 URL 生成 QR 码图片，支持下载和复制链接，自动适配暗色主题。

nodes.name: QrDialog
nodes.summary: QR 码弹窗组件，使用 qr.ts 生成 QR 码，支持暗色模式适配、下载和复制操作。

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: 侧边栏入口文件，初始化国际化和主题后挂载 SidePanel 组件。

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: 侧边栏应用组件，提供书签树浏览、搜索、文件夹展开/折叠、置顶书签和历史记录搜索功能。

nodes.name: SidePanel
nodes.summary: 侧边栏主组件，管理书签树加载、搜索、文件夹展开和搜索引擎切换。

nodes.name: SidepanelFolder
nodes.summary: 侧边栏文件夹组件，递归渲染子文件夹和书签链接，支持展开/折叠。

nodes.name: SearchResults
nodes.summary: 搜索结果组件，展示书签和历史记录搜索结果，带 favicon 显示。

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: 弹出窗口入口文件，初始化国际化和主题后挂载 Popup 组件。

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: 弹出窗口应用组件，提供打开新标签页、侧边栏、书签管理器和设置的快捷入口。

nodes.name: Popup
nodes.summary: 弹出窗口组件，渲染快捷操作按钮列表，支持打开新标签页和侧边栏。

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: 背景脚本（Service Worker），处理书签 AI 工具调用、右键菜单管理、浮动球控制和 QR 码标签页打开等后台任务。

nodes.name: executeBookmarkTool
nodes.summary: 执行 AI 书签工具调用的核心函数，支持 search_bookmarks、list_folders、create_bookmark、delete_bookmark 和 move_bookmark 五种操作。

nodes.name: collectFolders
nodes.summary: 递归收集书签树中所有文件夹，返回路径和书签数量信息。

nodes.name: setupContextMenus
nodes.summary: 初始化右键上下文菜单，创建复制链接、QR 码、复制标题等 8 个菜单项。

nodes.name: copyViaTab
nodes.summary: 通过 content script 在页面中执行复制操作，使用临时 textarea 和 execCommand 实现跨域复制。

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: 内容脚本，实现可拖拽浮动球（悬浮球）功能，注入 Shadow DOM 搜索面板，支持书签搜索、快捷键和站点级禁用。

nodes.name: injectStyles
nodes.summary: 注入大量 CSS 样式到 Shadow DOM，定义浮动球搜索面板的完整视觉样式，包括暗色模式适配。
nodes.languageNotes: 该函数包含约 235 行 CSS 字符串，是典型的 Shadow DOM 样式隔离方案。

nodes.name: mount
nodes.summary: 浮动球核心挂载函数，创建 Shadow DOM 宿主、搜索栏、结果面板和设置菜单，绑定所有事件监听器。

nodes.name: searchBookmarks
nodes.summary: 通过 chrome.runtime.sendMessage 向背景脚本发送书签搜索请求。

nodes.name: postcss.config.js
nodes.summary: PostCSS 配置文件，启用 Tailwind CSS 和 Autoprefixer 插件。

nodes.name: icons.mjs
nodes.summary: 图标生成脚本，使用 sharp 库将 SVG 源文件转换为 Chrome 扩展所需的各尺寸 PNG 图标。

nodes.name: postbuild.mjs
nodes.summary: 构建后处理脚本，复制清单文件、资源目录到 dist，并将子目录 HTML 文件移至根目录以适配 Chrome 扩展结构。

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: 主函数，执行完整的构建后处理流程：复制 manifest、assets、调整 HTML 路径、清理旧 dist。

nodes.name: zip.mjs
nodes.summary: 打包脚本，将 dist 目录压缩为 ZIP 文件用于 Chrome 扩展发布。

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite 构建配置，定义三个入口（newtab、popup、sidepanel）和 background 脚本的多入口打包方案。

nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts

tour.title: 项目概览
tour.description: 从 README.md 开始，了解 Smart Bookmark 的全部功能：书签清理中心、新标签页看板、AI 助手、对比搜索、悬浮球、二维码生成、备份恢复和 i18n 国际化。README 同时描述了项目的目录结构，为后续步骤提供导航地图。

tour.title: 核心类型定义
tour.description: src/types/index.ts 是整个项目被依赖最多的文件（fan-in 26），定义了 Settings、BookmarkNode、AiMessage、Issue 等所有核心接口。理解这些类型是理解后续所有模块的基础——每个 lib 和 page 都从这里导入类型契约。

tour.title: 基础设施库
tour.description: storage.ts（fan-in 10）封装 chrome.storage.local 与 localStorage 的双层持久化；utils.ts（fan-in 20）提供 cn 类名合并、faviconOf、normalizeUrl 等通用工具；i18n.ts（fan-in 17）实现中英文双语切换和 React useT hook。这三个模块构成了所有 UI 和业务逻辑的公共依赖层。
tour.languageLesson: React 自定义 hook（如 useT）将副作用逻辑封装为可复用函数。useT 内部订阅 i18n 语言变更事件，组件卸载时自动取消订阅，避免内存泄漏。

tour.title: 新标签页入口与路由
tour.description: src/newtab/main.tsx 初始化 i18n 和主题后挂载 App 组件。App.tsx（fan-out 15）通过 URL hash 实现轻量路由，在 Dashboard、Discover、Cleaner、Compare、AI、Backup、Settings 七个标签页之间切换。这个应用壳是新标签页看板的骨架。
tour.languageLesson: Chrome 扩展 MV3 的新标签页通过 HTML 文件声明入口，Vite 多入口配置将 main.tsx 编译为独立 bundle。URL hash 路由无需第三方库，用 window.location.hash 同步标签页状态。

tour.title: 看板核心页面
tour.description: Dashboard.tsx 是整个扩展最复杂的 UI 组件（fan-out 18），集成了书签文件夹树导航、搜索引擎切换、拖拽排序、面包屑、分页、Top Sites、趋势面板和右键菜单。它从 bookmarks.ts 加载书签树，从 engines.ts 获取搜索引擎配置，从 github.ts 拉取趋势数据，是各个 lib 模块的汇聚点。

tour.title: AI 助手系统
tour.description: ai.ts 实现 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 双后端 SSE 流式对话，aiTools.ts 定义书签操作的 function-calling 工具，aiBookmarkContext.ts 生成书签树摘要作为 AI 上下文，aiSessionDb.ts 用 IndexedDB 持久化会话。AiPanel.tsx（fan-out 12）将这些串联为完整的多轮对话界面，支持工具调用确认流程。
tour.languageLesson: SSE（Server-Sent Events）是单向流式传输协议，比 WebSocket 更适合 LLM 响应场景。chatAnthropic 使用 ReadableStream 读取 SSE 事件，逐 token 拼接工具调用参数，完成后再触发 executeBookmarkTool 执行。

tour.title: 书签清理与备份
tour.description: cleaner.ts 实现完整的书签扫描引擎：空文件夹检测、重复书签合并、失效链接探测（HEAD 请求并发控制）、死站检测，以及书签画像分析（域名统计、关键词提取、组织评分）。Cleaner.tsx 将扫描结果可视化。backup.ts 支持 JSON 和 Netscape HTML 两种格式的导入导出，带去重和文件夹创建逻辑。
tour.languageLesson: Netscape Bookmark File HTML 是浏览器书签的标准交换格式，用 <DL>/<DT>/<A> 标签嵌套表示文件夹和链接。parseNetscapeHtml 使用 DOMParser 将 HTML 字符串解析为 DOM 树后递归提取。

tour.title: 后台服务与内容脚本
tour.description: background/index.ts（Service Worker）处理 AI 工具调用路由（search/create/delete/move bookmark）、右键菜单管理和浮动球控制。content/index.ts 注入 Shadow DOM 悬浮球，通过 chrome.runtime.sendMessage 与 background 通信搜索书签。这两个文件构成了扩展的后台基础设施。
tour.languageLesson: Chrome MV3 的 Service Worker 替代了 MV2 的 background page，生命周期由浏览器管理，空闲时会被终止。Shadow DOM 将悬浮球的样式和 DOM 完全隔离，避免与宿主页面冲突。

tour.title: 主题与 UI 组件库
tour.description: themePresets.ts 定义颜色方案预设，theme.ts 处理暗色模式检测和 accent 色应用。ThemeSwitcher 和 ThemeToggle 提供主题切换 UI。src/components/ui/ 下的 shadcn/ui 组件（button、card、dialog、tabs、toast 等）基于 Radix UI 原语和 Tailwind CSS 构建，是所有页面的共享 UI 基础。
tour.languageLesson: shadcn/ui 不是 npm 包，而是直接复制到项目中的组件源码。每个组件用 cva（class-variance-authority）定义变体，cn() 工具合并 Tailwind 类名，实现类型安全的样式系统。

tour.title: 构建配置与扩展清单
tour.description: vite.config.ts 定义四个入口点（newtab、popup、sidepanel、background）的多入口打包方案。manifest.json（MV3）声明权限、背景脚本、内容脚本、侧边栏和快捷键。postbuild.mjs 将构建产物调整为 Chrome 扩展目录结构，zip.mjs 打包发布。这是扩展从源码到可安装产品的最后环节。
tour.languageLesson: Vite 的 rollupOptions.input 支持多入口打包，每个入口生成独立的 HTML 和 JS bundle。Chrome MV3 要求 background 脚本为 module 类型，Vite 的 build.rollupOptions.output 可以为每个入口指定输出文件名。
